1.text: Indirimbo y'Amazamuka.Bambabaje kenshi uhereye mu buto bwanjye,Abe ari ko ubwoko bw'Abisirayeli buvuga none.

2.text: Bambabaje kenshi, uhereye mu buto bwanjye,Ariko ntibanesheje.

3.text: Abahinzi bahinze ku mugongo wanjye,Bahaciye impavu ndende.

4.text: Uwiteka ni umukiranutsi,Yaciye ingoyi abanyabyaha banshyizeho.

5.text: Abanga i Siyoni bose,Bakorwe n'isoni basubizwe inyuma.

6.text: Babe nk'ubwatsi n'imyaka bimeze ku mapfundo y'amazu,Byuma bitarakura.

7.text: Ibyo umusaruzi atuzuza ikiganza cye,Cyangwa uhambira imiba atuzuza igikondorero cye.

8.text: Abahisi ntibavuge bati“Umugisha w'Uwiteka ube kuri mwe,Tubasabiye umugisha mu izina ry'Uwiteka.”
